name: Tirupati Brahmotsavam
description: Grand spiritual nine-day festival featuring chariot processions around the hill temple of Lord Venkateswara with Garuda Seva and Rathotsavam.
cultural_vibe: Devotional, Grand Temple Chariots, Vedic Chanting
attribution_text: TTD Cultural Archives / Wikimedia Commons CC BY-SA 4.0

name: Visakha Utsav
description: Cultural beach festival with traditional dances, craft stalls, coastal cuisine and local seafood celebrations along the Bay of Bengal shoreline.
cultural_vibe: Coastal Carnival, Folk Arts, Culinary Showcase

name: Ziro Festival of Music
description: Outdoor indie music and cultural arts festival celebrated in the picturesque terraced rice fields of the Apatani tribe in Ziro Valley.
cultural_vibe: Eco-friendly, Indie Beats, Apatani Heritage, Valley Camping

name: Losar Festival
description: Tibetan New Year featuring Buddhist monastic Cham masked dances, prayer ceremonies, and traditional feasts celebrated by the Monpa community.
cultural_vibe: Monastic Rituals, Masked Cham Dance, Sacred Horns

name: Bohag Bihu (Rongali Bihu)
description: Assamese New Year and spring festival celebrating agricultural harvest with energetic Bihu dance, dhol drumming, pepa horn melodies, and traditional pitha delicacies.
cultural_vibe: Joyful Folk Dance, Dhol Beats, Spring Merriment

name: Ambubachi Mela
description: Major tantric spiritual gathering and fair celebrated annually during the monsoon at the historic Kamakhya Temple atop Nilachal Hill.
cultural_vibe: Mystic Spiritual, Tantric Sadhus, Monsoon Devotion

name: Chhath Puja
description: Major ancient Vedic sun festival celebrated along the banks of the sacred Ganga, featuring fasting, offering arghya to the rising and setting Sun.
cultural_vibe: Sacred Riverbank Prayers, Sun Worship, Thekua Offerings

name: Sonepur Cattle Fair (Harihar Kshetra Mela)
description: Traditional heritage fair held on the confluence of rivers Ganga and Gandak near Patna, historic since Mauryan times featuring crafts, livestock, and folklore.
cultural_vibe: Centuries-Old Rural Fair, Handicrafts, River Confluence
source_name: Department of Tourism, Government of Bihar

name: Bastar Dussehra
description: The world's longest festival spanning 75 days, dedicated to goddess Danteshwari, featuring massive multi-wheeled chariot processions crafted by tribal artisans.
cultural_vibe: 75-Day Tribal Ceremony, Grand Wooden Chariot, Danteshwari Devotion

name: Goa Carnival
description: Colorful Portuguese-influenced street carnival featuring elaborate floats, King Momo decree, samba dancers, costumed parades, brass bands, and street festivities.
cultural_vibe: Carnivalesque, Susegad Celebration, Street Parades, Masquerade
associated_places: Church of Our Lady of the Immaculate Conception
source_name: Department of Tourism, Government of Goa

name: Sunburn / Supersonic Festivals
description: Asia's premier electronic dance music and lifestyle events drawing global artists and beachgoers along North Goa's dramatic red-cliff coastlines.
cultural_vibe: High Energy EDM, Coastal Sunset Rhythms, Youth Gathering

name: Gujarat Navratri Festival
description: World's longest dance festival lasting nine nights, where thousands participate in energetic Garba and Dandiya Raas circles in traditional chaniya cholis and kediyus.
cultural_vibe: Mesmerizing Garba Rhythms, Vibrant Traditional Attire, All-Night Dance

name: International Kite Festival (Uttarayan)
description: Celebration of Makar Sankranti where millions of colorful kites fill the skies over Ahmedabad's historic pols and the Sabarmati Riverfront with cries of 'Kai Po Che!'.
cultural_vibe: Rooftop Festivities, Airborne Spectacle, Sesame Sweets (Undhiyu & Chikki)

name: Rann Utsav
description: Winter desert carnival under the full moon on the white salt marsh of the Great Rann of Kutch, featuring Kutchi folk musicians, Rogan art, and luxury tent encampments.
cultural_vibe: White Desert Moonlit Nights, Kutchi Craftsmanship, Camel Safaris

name: Surajkund International Crafts Mela
description: The largest crafts fair in the world showcasing rural Indian handicrafts, handlooms, traditional performing arts, and international artisan pavilions against the 10th-century reservoir.
cultural_vibe: Rustic Crafts Wonderland, Live Artisan Weaving, Cultural Confluence
source_name: Haryana Tourism Authority / Surajkund Mela Authority

name: Kullu Dussehra
description: Centuries-old royal festival where over two hundred village deities arrive in palanquins to pay homage to Lord Raghunath at Dhalpur Maidan.
cultural_vibe: Congregation of Gods, Valley Horns, Royal Chariot Pull

name: Sarhul Spring Festival
description: Sacred tribal spring festival celebrating nature and the blooming of Sal tree blossoms, worshipped by Oraon, Munda and Ho communities.
cultural_vibe: Nature Reverence, Sal Tree Blossoms, Mandar Drum Dancing
source_name: Department of Tourism, Government of Jharkhand

name: Mysore Dasara
description: Magnificent royal state festival (Nada Habba) featuring the illumination of Mysore Palace with 100,000 bulbs and the regal Jumboo Savari elephant procession.
cultural_vibe: Royal Pageantry, Illuminated Palaces, Golden Howdah

name: Hampi Utsav (Vijaya Utsav)
description: Grand mega cultural festival held amidst the UNESCO World Heritage monuments of the Vijayanagara Empire, featuring classical performances and fireworks.
cultural_vibe: Imperial Grandeur, Monumental Lighting, Carnatic Rhythms
attribution_text: Hampi World Heritage Area Management Authority

name: Kambala Buffalo Race
description: Thrilling traditional wet paddy-field buffalo racing festival celebrated by the farming community across the coastal Tulu Nadu region.
cultural_vibe: Adrenaline Sport, Splashing Mud, Tulu Folk Culture
source_name: Department of Tourism, Government of Karnataka

name: Thrissur Pooram
description: The mother of all poorams, featuring the thunderous Ilanjithara Melam percussion orchestra, rhythmic changing of silk parasols (Kudamattam), and decorated tusker pageantry.
cultural_vibe: Thunderous Percussion (Chenda Melam), Parasol Exchange, Elephant Majesty

name: Onam Festival
description: Kerala's grand harvest festival welcoming the mythical King Mahabali, featuring floral carpets (Pookalam), Pulikali tiger dances, boat races, and the 26-dish Onasadya feast.
cultural_vibe: Golden Harvest, Floral Carpets, Tiger Dancers, Grand Sadya Feast
attribution_text: Department of Tourism, Government of Kerala

name: Nehru Trophy Boat Race
description: Iconic snake boat (Chundan Vallam) race on Punnamada Lake where over a hundred rowers in sleek 100-foot canoes paddle furiously to rhythmic Vanchipattu boat songs.
cultural_vibe: Frenzied Water Regatta, Synchronized 100-Oar Strokes, Backwater Cheers
typical_season: Monsoon (Second Saturday of August / Early September)

name: Khajuraho Dance Festival
description: Week-long classical dance festival set against the floodlit backdrop of the UNESCO Western Group of Khajuraho temples, presenting Kathak, Bharatanatyam, and Odissi maestros.
cultural_vibe: Classical Dance Elegance, Temple Floodlights, Sacred Architecture
source_name: Madhya Pradesh Tourism Board / Ustad Alauddin Khan Sangeet Academy

name: Tansen Music Festival (Tansen Samaroh)
description: India's oldest national classical music festival held near the historic tomb of legendary musical maestro Tansen, hosting leading vocalists and instrumentalists.
cultural_vibe: Sublime Hindustani Classical, Dhrupad Legends, Mughal Tomb Ambience
source_name: Department of Culture, Government of Madhya Pradesh

name: Ganeshotsav
description: Maharashtra's premier 10-day public festival founded by Lokmanya Tilak, featuring thousands of artisanal Ganpati mandals, Dhol-Tasha pathaks, and grand immersion processions at Girgaon Chowpatty.
cultural_vibe: Rousing Dhol-Tasha Rhythms, Modak Offerings, Sea Immersions
typical_season: Late Monsoon / Autumn (Bhadrapada Shukla Chaturthi to Anant Chaturdashi)

name: Ellora Ajanta International Festival
description: Celebration of classical music, Sufi singing, and dance held against the dramatic illuminated basalt facade of the Ellora Kailasa Temple and historical Soneri Mahal.
cultural_vibe: Ancient Cave Majesty, Classical Maestros, Heritage Illumination

name: Sangai Festival
description: Grand state tourism festival named after Manipur's brow-antlered deer, spotlighting Thang-Ta martial arts, classical Manipuri Raas Leela, polo heritage, and indigenous handlooms.
cultural_vibe: Polo Cradle Heritage, Raas Leela Grace, Thang-Ta Martial Energy
source_name: Department of Tourism, Government of Manipur

name: Wangala (100 Drums Festival)
description: Post-harvest festival of the Garo tribe paying homage to the Sun God Saljong, featuring the synchronized thumping of 100 traditional oval Nagra drums.
cultural_vibe: 100 Synced Drums, Feathered Headgear, Garo Harvest Thanksgiving

name: Shillong Cherry Blossom Festival
description: Autumn festival celebrating the blooming of pink Himalayan cherry blossoms across the Khasi Hills, combined with international music headliners and fashion shows.
cultural_vibe: Pink Himalayan Blossoms, Indie Rock Headliners, Misty Pine Valley
source_name: Department of Tourism, Government of Meghalaya

name: Chapchar Kut
description: Major Mizo spring festival marking the clearing of jhum forests, featuring the iconic Cheraw bamboo dance where dancers step rhythmically between clapped bamboo poles.
cultural_vibe: Cheraw Bamboo Dance, Mizo Traditional Puan Weaves, Spring Gaiety

name: Hornbill Festival
description: The acclaimed 'Festival of Festivals' uniting all 17 Naga indigenous tribes at the Naga Heritage Village of Kisama to present war dances, indigenous sports, and music.
cultural_vibe: Tribal War Horns, Feathered Regalia, Morung Architecture, Naga Rock
source_name: Department of Tourism, Government of Nagaland

name: Puri Rath Yatra
description: World-famous chariot festival where colossal wooden chariots of Lord Jagannath, Balabhadra and Subhadra are pulled by millions along Puri's Bada Danda to Gundicha Temple.
cultural_vibe: Mass Devotion, Colossal Wooden Chariots, Bada Danda Procession
source_name: Odisha Tourism / Shree Jagannatha Temple Administration

name: Konark Dance Festival
description: Premier national dance festival staged in an open-air amphitheatre with the illuminated UNESCO Konark Sun Temple as the majestic backdrop.
cultural_vibe: Classical Odissi & Bharatanatyam, Sun Temple Silhouette, Coastal Breeze

name: International Sand Art Festival
description: Global sand sculpting festival on the golden sands of Chandrabhaga Beach, featuring master sculptors creating intricate thematic sand monuments.
cultural_vibe: Transient Sand Sculptures, Golden Beach Canvases, Marine Creativity

name: Baisakhi (Vaisakhi)
description: Historic harvest and religious festival commemorating the creation of the Khalsa Panth in 1699 by Guru Gobind Singh Ji, celebrated with Bhangra and Gidda.
cultural_vibe: Rousing Bhangra, Golden Wheat Harvest, Golden Temple Illumination
source_name: Punjab Heritage and Tourism Promotion Board

name: Hola Mohalla
description: Grand Sikh martial arts festival instituted by Guru Gobind Singh Ji, featuring mock sword battles, Gatka demonstrations, horse racing feats, and langar kitchens.
cultural_vibe: Gatka Martial Arts, Horsemanship Feats, Nihang Warrior Pageantry
source_name: SGPC / Punjab Heritage and Tourism Promotion Board

name: Pushkar Camel Fair (Pushkar Mela)
description: One of the world's largest livestock and cultural fairs where thousands of colorfully adorned camels congregate along the desert sand dunes beside sacred Pushkar Lake.
cultural_vibe: Desert Carnival, Decorated Camels, Turban Competitions, Folk Music
source_name: Department of Tourism, Government of Rajasthan

name: Jaipur Literature Festival (JLF)
description: The 'greatest literary show on Earth', bringing together Nobel laureates, Man Booker winners, philosophers, and thinkers for lively intellectual discourse.
cultural_vibe: Literary Debate, Royal Haveli Ambience, World Intellectual Forum

name: Jaisalmer Desert Festival (Maru Mahotsav)
description: Three-day extravaganza among the golden Thar dunes featuring Rajasthani folk music, Kalbelia dancers, camel polo, and the famous Mr. Desert pageant.
cultural_vibe: Thar Golden Dunes, Ghoomar & Kalbelia Rhythms, Fire Dancers
source_name: Department of Tourism, Government of Rajasthan

name: Saga Dawa
description: Most sacred Tibetan Buddhist festival commemorating the birth, enlightenment, and parinirvana of Gautama Buddha with holy relic processions and butter lamp illuminations.
cultural_vibe: Serene Buddhist Chants, Butter Lamp Seas, Rumtek Cham Dances

name: Pongal Harvest Festival
description: Four-day Tamil Thanksgiving and harvest festival celebrating Sun God Surya, featuring boiling of sweet rice in clay pots until it overflows ('Pongalo Pongal!').
cultural_vibe: Traditional Kolam Art, Sugarcane Stalks, Overspilling Sweet Rice

name: Jallikattu (Bull Taming Event)
description: Ancient 2,000-year-old Tamil heritage event celebrated during Mattu Pongal where brave youths embrace the humps of ferocious native Pulikulam and Kangayam bulls.
cultural_vibe: Ancient Sangam Valor, Bull-Hugging Athletics, Village Roar
source_name: Tamil Nadu Tourism / Madurai District Administration

name: Margazhi Music & Dance Season
description: The world's largest cultural music festival spanning mid-December to mid-January, hosting over 1,500 Carnatic vocal, Veena, Mridangam, and Bharatanatyam concerts across sabhas.
cultural_vibe: Soulful Carnatic Kritis, Sabha Filter Coffee, Bharatanatyam Abhinaya

name: Bonalu
description: Telangana's state festival dedicated to Goddess Mahakali, where women carry brass pots decorated with neem leaves, turmeric, and lit lamps, led by whip-cracking Pothuraju dancers.
cultural_vibe: Pothuraju Trance Dance, Mahakali Offerings, Teen Maar Drums

name: Bathukamma Floral Festival
description: Nine-day floral festival celebrated by women who arrange seasonal wildflowers in conical tiers to venerate Goddess Gauri, accompanied by melodious folk songs.
cultural_vibe: Seven-Tier Floral Cones, Women's Folk Chants, Tank Bund Immersion
typical_season: Autumn (September / October - Mahalaya Amavasya to Durgashtami)
source_name: Government of Telangana Department of Culture

name: Kharchi Puja
description: Sacred seven-day festival worshipping the Fourteen Deities (Chaturdasha Devata) at Old Agartala, celebrated to cleanse the earth and invite good fortune.
cultural_vibe: Fourteen Deities Worship, Saidra River Rituals, Royal Tripura Heritage

name: International Yoga Festival
description: Week-long international yoga and wellness gathering on the banks of the sacred Ganga in Rishikesh, uniting spiritual masters, yogis, and seekers from over 80 nations.
cultural_vibe: Spiritual Enlightenment, Ganga Sunrise Asanas, Sacred Kirtan

name: Lathmar Holi
description: Legendary Braj festival reenacting the play of Radha and Krishna, where women of Barsana playfully beat men of Nandgaon with wooden sticks (lathis) under showers of gulal.
cultural_vibe: Playful Lathi Clashes, Clouds of Herbal Gulal, Braj Temple Songs

name: Dev Deepawali (Diwali of the Gods)
description: Spectacular festival of lights celebrated fifteen days after Diwali on Kartik Purnima, when all 84 ghats of Varanasi are illuminated with over one million earthen diyas.
cultural_vibe: One Million Glowing Diyas, Grand Maha Aarti, River Reflections
attribution_text: Shri Kashi Vishwanath Special Area Development Board

name: Kolkata Durga Puja
description: UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity celebrated as the world's greatest public art carnival, featuring thematic pandals, traditional Dhunuchi dance, and idol immersion.
cultural_vibe: UNESCO Intangible Heritage, Architectural Pandals, Dhunuchi Rhythms
typical_season: Autumn (September / October - Ashwin Shukla Shashthi to Dashami)
source_name: UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage / West Bengal Tourism
license: UNESCO Representative List / Government Open Data

name: Island Tourism Festival
description: Ten-day carnival celebrating island culture, tribal heritage, coastal watersports, orchestral performances, and handicraft exhibitions.
cultural_vibe: Island Vibes, Tropical Beach Watersports, Nicobari Folk Art
associated_places: Ross Island (Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose Dweep)
source_name: Directorate of Tourism, Andaman & Nicobar Administration

name: Chandigarh Rose Festival
description: Spring cultural festival hosted in Asia's largest Rose Garden, celebrating over 50,000 rose bushes of 1,600 varieties with musical nights, food stalls, and helicopter rides.
cultural_vibe: Floral Splendor, Modernist Park Leisure, Classical Concerts

name: Garba & Nariyal Poornima
state: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
description: Coastal fishermen festival offering coconut to the sea to mark the end of the monsoon, celebrated with traditional Portuguese-influenced folk dances and seaside Garba.
cultural_vibe: Fisherfolk Sea Worship, Coconut Offerings, Portuguese-Gujarati Fusion
attribution_text: Administration of UT of Daman & Diu

name: Qutub Festival
description: Three-day classical music and Sufi dance festival set in the floodlit courtyard of the 12th-century UNESCO World Heritage Qutub Minar complex.
cultural_vibe: Sufi Qawwali, 12th Century Minar Illumination, Winter Delhi Nights
source_name: Delhi Tourism and Transportation Development Corporation (DTTDC)

name: India Art Fair
description: South Asia's leading international modern and contemporary art fair presenting pioneering regional art, heritage restoration installations, and international galleries.
cultural_vibe: Contemporary Art Frontier, Global Collectors, Avant-Garde Sculptures

name: Shikara Festival
description: Cultural carnival along the waters of Dal Lake where decorated wooden shikaras participate in races, floating craft bazaars, and traditional Kashmiri music performances.
cultural_vibe: Floating Gondolas of the East, Pir Panjal Reflections, Kehwa Gatherings

name: Tulip Festival
description: Spring celebration in Asia's largest tulip garden boasting over 1.5 million blooming tulips in sixty varieties overlooking the Dal Lake.
cultural_vibe: Millions of Vivid Tulips, Zabarwan Mountain Backdrop, Spring Radiance
source_name: Department of Floriculture, J&K / J&K Tourism

name: Ladakh Festival
description: Grand cultural festival celebrating Himalayan traditions with traditional polo tournaments, archery competitions, monastic dances, and folk music across the high plateau.
cultural_vibe: High-Altitude Polo, Archery Feats, Silk Brocade Regalia
source_name: Ladakh Autonomous Hill Development Council (LAHDC) / Tourism Department
attribution_text: UT Administration of Ladakh Tourism Records

name: Hemis Festival (Hemis Tsechu)
description: Celebration of the birth anniversary of Guru Padmasambhava at Ladakh's largest monastery, featuring mystic sacred Cham masked dances and display of the grand thangka.
cultural_vibe: Monastic Drums & Cymbals, Cham Masked Dances, Sacred Silk Thangkas
typical_season: Early Summer (June / July - 10th day of Tibetan lunar month)

name: National Mini-Toy Festival
description: Local coral island cultural celebration featuring traditional coconut-shell handicrafts, handmade miniature wooden sailing toys, and marine heritage displays.
cultural_vibe: Coconut Shell Craftsmanship, Island Folk Songs, Coral Lagoon Rejoicing

name: Bastille Day (French National Day)
description: Franco-Tamil cultural celebration marking the storming of the Bastille, featuring torchlit parades by retired French soldiers, Indo-French musical bands, and fireworks along the Promenade.
cultural_vibe: French Quarter Elegance, Torchlight Veterans Parade, Tricolore Tributes
source_name: Tourism Department, Government of Puducherry / Consulate General of France

name: International Yoga Festival
description: Annual global wellness festival celebrating yogic science, meditation, philosophical debates, and coastal sunrise yogic sadhana.
cultural_vibe: Coastal Serenity, Yogic Science, Auroville Contemplation
source_name: Department of Tourism, Government of Puducherry
